title: Basic Use of Dewalt DW716 Miter Saw in Biological and Agricultural Engineering Labs
author: Lee Schrader
materials: Setup equipment Check electrical cable and be sure it is free from damage (e.g., exposed wire) If necessary, plug in the saw to a 120V 60Hz outlet. Ensure stable placement of the miter saw on the workbench (equipment should not be wobbling with a gentle shake)

steps.title: Check Personal Protective Equipment
steps.instruction: Wear all required PPE: safety glasses, closed‑toe shoes, and hearing protection (recommended).

steps.title: Set Saw Angles and Mark Cut
steps.instruction: Adjust the saw to the desired angles and mark the material.

substeps.instruction: Set miter angle (left/right rotation) if cutting at an angle.
Set bevel angle (blade tilt) if required.
Using a pencil or marker, clearly mark the cut line(s) on the material.

steps.title: Position Material Securely
steps.instruction: Place and secure the workpiece on the table before cutting.

substeps.instruction: Place material flat on the table.
Hold the workpiece firmly against the fence with one hand.
Align the blade with the marked cut line without powering on the saw.
Optionally, use clamps to firmly position the material.
Do not cut extremely small pieces that cannot be safely secured.

steps.title: Perform Cutting Operation
steps.instruction: Start the saw and cut through the material while observing safety checks.

substeps.instruction: Raise the blade clear of the material.
Press and hold the trigger to start the blade.
Allow the blade to reach full speed; listen for a constant hum.
If the motor sounds abnormal, slows, vibrates, or struggles, stop immediately and notify shop personnel.
Ensure no loose clothing can contact the blade.
Keep hands away from the blade at all times.
Using the right hand, slowly lower the blade through the material.
Maintain steady pressure; do not force the cut.
Complete the cut through the material.
Release the trigger to stop the blade.
Allow the blade to stop completely before raising it.

steps.title: Finish and Inspect Cut
steps.instruction: Complete the cut sequence and verify accuracy.

substeps.instruction: Keep the blade down until it stops spinning.
Raise the blade slowly after it has stopped.
Remove the material carefully.
Inspect the cut for accuracy.

steps.title: Clean Up and Store Equipment
steps.instruction: Turn off power, clean the area, and store tools and PPE.

substeps.instruction: Turn off power to the saw.
Remove debris from the table and surrounding area.
Inspect the power cord for damage and store it away from walkways.
Store the saw and accessories properly.
Return reusable PPE (safety glasses, hearing protection) to its proper location.
